canonical_project: TLSSC Bebonuk Cable Landing Station (Timor-Leste South Submarine Cable System)
owner: Cabos de Timor-Leste (CTL, state-owned); cable by Alcatel Submarine Networks; Dili landing station by DXN
notes: TLSSC (607 km, 27 Tbps) landed at Bebonuk, Dili in June 2024 and was commercially launched by CTL in 2026 (Developing Telecoms/DCD). Recorded as connectivity anchor per methodology: cable capacity (27 Tbps) is NOT datacenter IT load; not a commercial colo unless colocation/service evidence appears. DXN built the Dili landing station (deal ~USD 1.4m per DCD).
